title: McDonald’s and Uber Expand Delivery and Rewards Partnership Across 14 Markets
summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) and McDonald’s Corporation (NYSE:MCD) have announced a multi-year expansion of their partnership, introducing additional delivery services and loyalty programme benefits across 14 international markets. The agreement covers the United States, Australia, Belgium, Canada, France, Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Poland, Portugal, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.
